theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G O : Set (Euclid P)) (RZ RX RY : IMRep U n) (Y S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsOpen G → CompactlyContained G U → IsOpen O → G ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ x ∈ G, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ) → RY.Represents Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Y ω = RZ.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + RX.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (RZ.carrier ∩ G)), f x = x ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, RZ.orient x (α.compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) = RZ.orient x α) → μHE[n] (RX.carrier \ G) = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, S ω = RZ.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) + ∫ x in RX.carrier, (RX.mult x : ℝ) * RX.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → S.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Λ ^ n) * RY.measure G
